caseName: People ex rel. Rayburn v. Binns
caseNameFull: People of the State of Illinois on the Relation of George F. Rayburn, in Error v. Hugh A. Binns
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Illinois.
attorneys: Mr. Edward D. Blinn for plaintiffs in error., No appearance for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction on the authority of Castillo v. McConnico, 168 U. S. 674; Butler v. Gage, 138 U. S. 52; Erie Railroad Company v. Purdy, 185 U. S. 148. See 192 Illinois, 68.
